newsitem.title: USA: Fed denies it plans to adopt core CPI target.
newsitem.headline: Fed denies it plans to adopt core CPI target.

text.p: The Federal Reserve on Tuesday denied a Reuters report saying that it was close to adopting a core Consumer Price Index target as a guideline for setting monetary policy.
"We are not targeting core inflation formally or informally," said Bob Moore, a spokesman for the Fed.
The Labor Department's core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, is closely watched by economists as a gauge of underlying inflation.

In a story that ran on Sept. 23, a Fed source told Reuters that the central bank viewed a zero-to-two percent range on core CPI as price stability. The source added that targeting core CPI as a guideline for policy had been informally adopted within the Fed.
However, Moore said, "The story is incorrect."
